create_sequence_feature: create a Sequence feature wrapping an inner feature with an optional static length
encode_sequence_example: encode a dict of lists into stacked numpy arrays for a Sequence feature
get_sequence_tensor_info: get tensor info with the sequence length dimension added to inner feature shapes
transpose_dict_list: transpose a nested dict of lists into a list of nested dicts for sequence processing
stack_nested_sequence: recursively stack tensors from the same dict field across sequence elements
